title: Native Path Repro V2
objective: Make production native wrappers, addons, and indexes byte-identical across clean checkouts at different absolute roots while preserving exact inspectable provenance

oracles: two clean builds from distinct absolute roots compare byte-for-byte
strict production autoload and native compiler regression tests

handoff.summary: Production native compilation now uses canonical logical source identities and deterministic compiler path maps instead of checkout paths. The production wrapper/index do not contain private physical source paths, foreign inputs are identified by logical role plus exact content hashes, and Linux builds set a fixed epoch and deterministic archive environment. A durable verifier rebuilt all 17 production kernels at exact commit 979e9c5 in detached checkouts /tmp/sagejs-native-repro/a and /tmp/sagejs-native-repro/b: all 35 published files were byte-identical, inventory SHA-256 63f0ce7c4b275789874d1f1f75613cd1fd19c872e8b63191017adc75ba40dc66 and index SHA-256 aed55d7fca52ce90e03c14ea75c363e7957928919706e06da7488c2c3af5d2e7, with neither checkout root embedded. The same independent reviewer that blocked d3227e5 approved exact tip 979e9c5 after all findings were fixed.
risks: Eleven production addons still contain a third historical worktree path inherited as live __FILE__ string data from prebuilt FLINT static archives. That is a mature dependency-build input, not compiler/wrapper output, and must be removed when the dependency-build lane lands its prefix-map policy.
Windows junction and /pathmap behavior are covered structurally, but a complete two-checkout Windows native build remains a release-platform validation step.
The clean-root verifier deliberately fails on any private path from either tested checkout; it does not attempt to whitelist or rewrite paths inherited from separately supplied static archives.
next_steps: Integrate 979e9c5 or this metadata-only descendant after the portable native-profile work that overlaps dependency build scripts.

Apply equivalent reproducible source/build prefix maps while rebuilding GMP, FLINT, MPFR, MPC, and other mature static dependencies, then assert that no historical builder root remains in published addons.
Run the durable verifier on macOS arm64 and Windows x64 release builders, retaining the resulting inventories as release evidence.
